original.target_description: Original 2018 Gerlicher et al. study verified by title/DOI. Day-2 postextinction vmPFC reactivations predicting day-3 differential SCR; scan time/model not specified.

n.location: Results, “Reactivations of a CS+ offset-related vmPFC pattern predict extinction memory retrieval”; Fig. 2b. Supplied HTML-derived canonical text has no page delimiters; no PDF supplied. Methods, “Skin conductance responses”.
n.quote: Critically, the number of potential vmPFC pattern reactivations during the 45-min postextinction scan negatively predicted CRs at test on day 3 (multiple linear regression: β 45 min = −0.13, SE = 0.03, T 30 = −4.05, P = 0.0003; n = 35; Fig. 2b ; for control analyses, see Supplementary Figs. 2 , 3 ). ... If more than 75% of trials had to be scored as zero, data of that subject/day was considered invalid. This applied to n = 3/4/5 (day 1/day 2/day 3) participants. For statistical analysis of each day’s SCR data we included all available data, i.e., n = 37/36/35 on day 1/day 2/day 3, respectively.

es.location: Results, “Reactivations of a CS+ offset-related vmPFC pattern predict extinction memory retrieval”; Fig. 2b. Supplied HTML-derived canonical text has no page delimiters; no PDF supplied.
es.quote: Critically, the number of potential vmPFC pattern reactivations during the 45-min postextinction scan negatively predicted CRs at test on day 3 (multiple linear regression: β 45 min = −0.13, SE = 0.03, T 30 = −4.05, P = 0.0003; n = 35; Fig. 2b ; for control analyses, see Supplementary Figs. 2 , 3 ). ... Reactivations during the scans 10 or 90 min after extinction did not significantly predict CRs ( β 10 min = −0.01, SE = 0.04, T 30 = −0.17, P = 0.86; β 90 min = 0.06, SE = 0.04, T 30 = 1.71, P = 0.10). ... The administration of l -DOPA did not affect the predictive relationship between number of CS+ offset-related vmPFC reactivations and CRs at test, but comparable relationships between number of vmPFC reactivations and CRs at test were found in each group (multiple linear regression: interaction reactivations × group, P = 0.99; simple slope analysis placebo: β = −0.09, P = 0.04, l -DOPA: β = −0.09, P = 0.07; n = 35; Fig. 2b ).

notes: The supplied descriptions and p. 3 locators for audit IDs 77, 78 and 79 are identical and do not specify scan time or model. The main regression prints beta45min = −0.13, SE = 0.03, T30 = −4.05, P = 0.0003, n = 35; beta10min = −0.01, SE = 0.04, T30 = −0.17, P = 0.86; beta90min = 0.06, SE = 0.04, T30 = 1.71, P = 0.10. All p values are exact as printed. The same section also prints simple slopes placebo beta = −0.09, P = 0.04 and L-DOPA beta = −0.09, P = 0.07, with n = 35 for the combined analysis. Fig. 2g separately prints path b beta = −0.10, SE = 0.03, T33 = −4.26, P = 0.0002, n = 35. No candidate is assigned by ID/order. Beta standardisation is not explicitly established in the inspected Methods. N = 35 is an explicit main-model candidate only, not a resolved row-specific N. The source excludes five day-3 SCR datasets as invalid (>75% zero trials); these are participants, not imaging volumes. No N inferred from df or summed. Unassigned fields are null placeholders and must not overwrite prior verified values. No replication source or narrative verdict assigned.
